c.responsibility: Design a reusable search suggestion widget for a product search box. Suggestions come from a remote endpoint. A user may type, clear, select, change language or use only the keyboard; requests can finish out of order.
c.contract: props: identity, locale and initial data; events: selection, change, retry; local contract below
c.rendering: Mid-range phone, long-tail latency, at most 10 suggestions mounted; target immediate input feedback before network completion.
c.accessibility: Use combobox/listbox semantics, labelled input, aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant; Arrow keys move active option, Enter commits, Escape closes. Keep DOM focus in input and announce result count politely.

n.no: Coordinates this feature. Debounce the fetch by an illustrative 200 ms; abort the previous lookup and also compare requestGeneration before committing. A late response for ca must never overwrite cam. Input text remains separate from the committed selection. Alternative: Fetch on each change with request identity for small workloads; debounce saves traffic but delays first suggestions. A headless controlled component supports reuse while a wrapper owns caching.
